tools.name: asset_compile
tools.title: Asset Compile
tools.description: Recompile an asset from its source file. Compile errors and warnings land in the console - check read_console after a failure.

path.description: Asset path, as returned by asset_search.

full.description: Force a full recompile instead of an incremental one.

tools.name: asset_dependencies
tools.title: Asset Dependencies
tools.description: Walk an asset's relationships - the assets it references (uses), the assets that depend on it, or the assets it was generated from. Deep recurses the whole chain, e.g. a model's materials and their textures.

path.description: Asset path, as returned by asset_search.

deep.description: Recurse instead of returning only direct relationships.

type.description: Filter results to one asset type - a file extension or friendly name. See asset_types.

Total.description: How many related assets exist, beyond what's shown.

tools.name: asset_files
tools.title: Asset Files
tools.description: The loose disk files behind an asset - the input files it's built from (.fbx, .tga, .png...), extra content and game files it ships with, and reference paths that couldn't be resolved to assets.

path.description: Asset path, as returned by asset_search.

tools.name: asset_info
tools.title: Asset Info
tools.description: Everything about one asset - name, type, source and compiled file paths, compile state, tags, cloud package, and how many assets it references and is used by. Explore those relationships with asset_dependencies.

path.description: Asset path, as returned by asset_search. Absolute paths work too.

tools.name: asset_read
tools.title: Asset Read
tools.description: Read a game resource asset's raw json - the actual data of a prefab, sound event, clothing definition or any other GameResource type. Doesn't work on binary assets like models and textures.

path.description: Asset path, as returned by asset_search.

tools.name: asset_search
tools.title: Asset Search
tools.description: Search the asset system by keywords and type. An empty query lists every asset, so use limit and offset to page through. Returns relative asset paths - pass one to asset_info, asset_compile, asset_read or asset_dependencies.

query.description: Space separated keywords. Every keyword must match the asset's path or one of its tags. Empty matches everything.

type.description: Filter to one asset type - a file extension (vmdl, vmat, prefab) or friendly name (Model, Material). See asset_types.

projectOnly.description: Only assets belonging to the currently open project, excluding engine content and cloud downloads.

unreferencedOnly.description: Only assets nothing else references - useful for finding unused assets. Note map files and code can use an asset without the asset system knowing.

compileFailedOnly.description: Only assets whose last compile failed.

uncompiledOnly.description: Only assets with no compiled version at all.

offset.description: How many results to skip, for paging.

Total.description: How many assets matched in total, beyond this page.

tools.name: asset_thumbnail
tools.title: Asset Thumbnail
tools.description: Render an asset's preview thumbnail and return it as an image - see what a model, material or texture actually looks like.

path.description: Asset path, as returned by asset_search.

tools.name: asset_types
tools.title: Asset Types
tools.description: Every asset type the editor knows, with the file extensions and category of each. Use a type's extension or name to filter asset_search.

Extension.description: The extension asset_search's type filter takes.

tools.name: asset_write
tools.title: Asset Write
tools.description: Overwrite a game resource asset's json and recompile it. Read the current json with asset_read first, modify it, and pass the whole document back - this replaces the entire file. Doesn't work on binary assets like models and textures.

path.description: Asset path, as returned by asset_search.

json.description: The complete json document to write.

tools.name: bridge_scatter_props
tools.title: Native Scatter Props
tools.description: Scatter model props with a repeatable seed, optional ground snapping, rotation, scaling and grouping. Requires stopped play mode. Uses the existing Bridge helper's scene and undo behaviour.

model.description: Project-relative model path, as returned by asset_search.

center.description: World-space centre as x,y,z, in Source units.

radius.description: Finite, nonnegative scatter radius in Source units.

snapToGround.description: Trace downward to place each prop on the ground.

group.description: Parent the props under a new group object.

name.description: Name prefix for the created objects.

tools.name: create_game_object
tools.title: Create Game Object
tools.description: Create a game object in the active scene - empty or from a prefab, optionally with components. For putting a model in the scene, spawn_model is quicker. The user can undo this. Returns the new object's id for the other scene tools.

name.description: Name for the new object. Empty picks a sensible default.

parent.description: Parent game object id. Empty parents to the scene root.

prefab.description: Prefab asset path to instantiate, from asset_search.

scale.description: Scale as 'x,y,z', or a single number for uniform.

components.description: Comma separated component type names to add, e.g. 'ModelRenderer,BoxCollider'.

tools.name: hammer_create_game_object
tools.title: Create Game Object
tools.description: Put a game object in the open map - empty, from a prefab, and/or with components and their properties set in the same call. This is how s&box gameplay goes in a map. The user can undo the creation. Returns the new node, whose GameObject field is the object's guid.

name.description: Name for the object. Empty uses the prefab's name, or 'GameObject'.

prefab.description: Prefab asset path to instantiate, from asset_search type:prefab.

components.description: Components to add, as a json object of type name to properties - e.g. {"ModelRenderer": {"Model": "models/dev/box.vmdl"}, "BoxCollider": {}}. get_component_type documents types and properties. A type the prefab already has gets its properties set instead.

tools.name: hammer_open_map
tools.title: Open Map
tools.description: Open a map (.vmap) in Hammer, opening Hammer itself if it isn't already. Loading happens in the background - poll hammer_status until MapOpen is true and Map matches.

path.description: Map asset path, e.g. 'maps/test.vmap' - asset_search type:vmap finds maps.

tools.name: open_scene
tools.title: Open Scene
tools.description: Open a scene from the asset system and make it the active tab. Already open scenes are just brought to the front. Play mode has to be stopped first - play_start then runs this scene.

path.description: Scene asset path, like "scenes/menu-main.scene". asset_search finds them.
